also_known_as.en: The Old Man of the Morea

summary.en: Klepht, mercenary officer in British service on Zakynthos, and the most capable Greek commander of the War of Independence. He took Tripolitsa in 1821 and broke Dramali's army at Dervenakia in 1822.
British admiral commanding the allied fleet at Navarino in 1827. He had orders to enforce an armistice without fighting, and destroyed the Ottoman and Egyptian fleet in an afternoon.
Corfiot diplomat, joint foreign minister of Russia, and from 1828 the first head of state of independent Greece. He built the institutions of the new state and was assassinated in Nafplio in 1831.

The most famous of the philhellenes. He came to Messolonghi in January 1824 with money and a plan to take Lepanto, and died of fever there in April. His death turned European opinion decisively toward the Greek cause.

Eldest son of Muhammad Ali of Egypt. His disciplined Egyptian army landed in the Peloponnese in 1825 and had reconquered most of it, and taken Messolonghi, before the loss of the fleet at Navarino cut him off.

Phanariot officer in the Russian army and leader of the Filiki Eteria from 1820. He opened the revolution by crossing into Moldavia in February 1821, in an expedition that collapsed within four months.
Second son of King Ludwig of Bavaria, chosen by the Powers in 1832 as the first King of Greece. He landed at Nafplio in February 1833 aged seventeen and was deposed in 1862.

Danish prince elected King of the Hellenes in 1863. His reign of fifty years saw the kingdom gain the Ionian Islands, Thessaly, Epirus, Macedonia and Crete. He was assassinated in Thessaloniki five months after its capture.

Cretan lawyer and revolutionary who became the dominant Greek statesman of the twentieth century. He led the country through the Balkan Wars and the First World War, and negotiated both Sèvres and Lausanne.

Staff officer, royalist, and from 1936 dictator of Greece under the Fourth of August regime. His refusal of the Italian ultimatum on 28 October 1940 took Greece into the Second World War. He died three months before the German invasion.
